depositPolicy.description: 0% advance deposit for private transfers and land walking tours (pay on arrival). 20% advance deposit for sea excursions, sandbanks, and boat charters to secure private vessel captains, fuel, and fresh morning seafood catering. 30% advance deposit for fly-in safaris to secure non-refundable flight seats and park permits.

zones.name: Stone Town
zones.description: UNESCO World Heritage site — the historic heart of Zanzibar with winding alleys, carved doors, bustling markets, and centuries of Swahili, Arab, Indian, and European heritage.

zones.name: Nungwi
zones.description: Northern tip of Zanzibar — famous for white-sand beaches, turquoise water, traditional dhow building, and vibrant nightlife. Turtles, diving, and sunset cruises.

zones.name: Kendwa
zones.description: Northwest coast — wide beaches with no tide restrictions, famous for full-moon parties, diving, and easy swimming all day.

zones.name: Paje
zones.description: Southeast coast — world-class kite-surfing, shallow turquoise lagoon, laid-back vibe, and easy access to Jozani Forest and Kuza Cave.

zones.name: Jambiani
zones.description: Southeast fishing village — authentic Swahili culture, seaweed farming, tide pools, and access to Kuza Cave and Chumbe Island.

zones.name: Kiwengwa
zones.description: Northeast coast — long white-sand beach, all-inclusive resorts, calm waters protected by reef, and easy access to Mnemba Atoll.

zones.name: Pongwe / Michamvi
zones.description: East-central coast — quiet beaches, mangrove channels, The Rock Restaurant nearby, and Isaraya overwater villas.

zones.name: Bwejuu / Dongwe
zones.description: Southeast coast — tranquil beaches, luxury boutique resorts, seaweed farming, and access to Chumbe Island marine park.

zones.name: Michamvi / Pingwe
zones.description: East coast — The Rock Restaurant on a coral outcrop, calm lagoon waters, and boutique luxury resorts.

zones.name: Kizimkazi / Dimbani
zones.description: South coast — dolphin watching capital, ancient mosque (12th century), and access to Menai Bay Conservation Area.

zones.name: Fumba / Mbweni
zones.description: Southwest peninsula — departure point for Safari Blue, marine conservation area access, and quiet residential beaches.

zones.name: Matemwe / Kigomani
zones.description: Northeast coast — pristine beaches, Mnemba Atoll access, turtle nesting sites, and quiet boutique properties.

zones.name: Chake Chake (Pemba)
zones.description: Main town of Pemba Island — authentic Swahili culture, clove plantations, and access to Pemba's pristine dive sites.

zones.name: Wambaa Gulf / Makangale (Pemba)
zones.description: Pemba's luxury lodge area — Fundu Lagoon, world-class diving, and untouched coral reefs.
